dimensions.assessment: Affects FAA personnel, aviation trade associations, advanced air mobility stakeholders, and prospective aircraft certification applicants.
dimensions.evidence: trade associations and advanced air mobility stakeholders that represent prior and prospective applicants for type certificates

dimensions.assessment: Imposes new procedural requirements, timelines, transparency measures, and reporting metrics on the FAA certification process.
dimensions.evidence: establish a range of standard expected timelines for... achievement of major milestones established in the type certification process

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal spending amounts or revenue impacts are stated in the source.
Directs the FAA Administrator to update official orders, issue guidance, create public plans, and submit regular reports to congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: the Administrator shall amend FAA order 8110.112A... to establish a range of standard expected timelines

dimensions.assessment: Requires initial implementation steps within 90 to 270 days and ongoing annual reports to Congress.
dimensions.evidence: annually thereafter, the Administrator... shall submit to the Committee... a report on the status

missing_information: Cost estimates or budget impacts for implementing the new FAA timelines and guidance are absent.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the FAA to publish plans and amend orders to establish standard expected timelines, transparent criteria for issue papers, and updated delegation guidance for type certification of aircraft and technologies.
